sources.standard: JESD209-5C, LPDDR5 SDRAM, x16, BG mode, WCK:CK 4:1, DVFSC/Enhanced DVFSC, link ECC and DBI disabled
sources.architecture: Table 6 (16Gb x16 BG mode): 4 BG x 4 banks, 65,536 rows, 1024 columns (64 x BL16); per2BankOffset 8: REFpb refreshes banks n and n+8 (7.5.1, Table 235)
sources.tCK: 1250 ps = 1 / upper CK limit of the 6400 row of Table 225 (MR2 OP[3:0] = 1011B), rounded up to 1 ps
sources.RL/RBTP: Table 225 (7.4.8.1), MR2 OP[3:0] = 1011B: RL Set 0 = 17, nRBTP = 4 = RU(tRBTP/tCK), tRBTP = max(7.5 ns, 2nCK) - 2nCK (Table 221)
sources.WR: Table 230 (7.4.8.3), x16 without DVFSC and write link ECC: nWR = 28 = RU(tWR/tCK), tWR = max(34 ns, 3nCK) (Table 381)
sources.RCD_L/RCD_S: Table 381: tRCD ACT-2 to READ max(18 ns, 2nCK) (RCD_L), ACT-2 to WRITE max(18 ns, 2nCK) (RCD_S)
sources.RPpb/RPab/RAS: Table 381: max(18 ns, 2nCK) / max(21 ns, 2nCK) / max(42 ns, 3nCK)
sources.RRD/FAW: Table 381: tRRD max(5 ns, 2nCK), tFAW 20 ns
sources.BL_n_16: Table 339, BG mode, 4:1, WCK > 1600 MHz, BL16: BL/n_min 2, BL/n_max 4; same BG 4, different BG 2
sources.BL_n_32/RTW_32: 0 = unused: BL32 in BG mode is rejected by MemSpecLPDDR5
sources.RTW_16: Tables 347/348 (8.2.2.1, RDQS on, NT-ODT and DQ ODT off): RL + BL/n_max (same BG) or BL/n_min (different BG) + RU(tWCK2DQO(max)/tCK) - WL
sources.WCK2DQO: RU(tWCK2DQO_HF(max) / tCK), tWCK2DQO_HF(max) = 1600 ps (Table 462, 15.3); read data starts at RL + WCK2DQO
sources.ACT-1/ACT-2: ACT-2 within tAAD = 8 nCK of ACT-1 (7.3.1); timings that end or start at an ACTIVATE refer to ACT-2; tAAD is fixed in MemSpecLPDDR5 (not in the DRAMUtils schema)
sources.mempowerspec/memimpedancespec: no public source for currents, supply voltages or I/O impedances: all zero, so DRAMPower reports 0 J; fill in device values for energy results
